paper.title_en: The shadow radius lower bound is more robust than the photon sphere radius lower bound in $n$-dimensional Einstein gravity
paper.abstract_en: The photon sphere and the black hole shadow are two closely related geometric features of strong-field spacetimes: the photon sphere is a hypersurface foliated by circular null geodesics, while the shadow boundary is determined by the critical impact parameter for null-geodesic capture. For static, spherically symmetric, asymptotically flat black holes in $n$-dimensional ($n\ge4$) Einstein gravity with anisotropic matter, we derive lower bounds on the shadow radius and the photon sphere radius and compare their matter assumptions. Assuming that an auxiliary function $Ξ(r)$ satisfies $-ρ\leΞ\le p_r$ and $(r^2Ξ)'\ge0$ between the horizon and the photon sphere under consideration, we establish $r_γ\ge[(n-1)/2]^{1/(n-3)}r_H$, where $r_H$ is the event horizon radius. Writing the shadow radius as $r_{\mathrm{sh}}=[\max_{r>r_H}U(r)]^{-1/2}$, where $U(r)$ is the null effective potential, we obtain $r_{\mathrm{sh}}/r_H\ge[(n-1)/2]^{1/(n-3)}\sqrt{(n-1)/(n-3)}$ using only $ρ\ge0$ and $ρ+p_r\ge0$, both implied by the weak energy condition (WEC). This shadow bound holds irrespective of the number of photon spheres and does not require the additional matter conditions used in the photon sphere lower-bound proofs. In this sense, the lower bound on the shadow radius is more robust than that on the photon sphere radius. A four-dimensional configuration satisfying the WEC has a single exterior photon sphere and obeys the shadow bound while violating the photon sphere lower-bound inequality, demonstrating this distinction even when both radii are associated with the same photon sphere. Both lower bounds are saturated by the Schwarzschild--Tangherlini solution. In Appendix~A, we also derive the mass-dependent upper bounds under the WEC, the strong energy condition, and suitable asymptotic decay assumptions.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文在 n 维爱因斯坦引力下比较了光子球半径与黑洞阴影半径的下界，并指出阴影半径下界对物质假设的要求更弱，因而更具稳健性，属于广义相对论基础与强场时空几何的核心理论问题。理论推导细致，结构清晰，对无度规假设下的紧致性结果有明确贡献。
decision.title_zh: 在 $n$ 维爱因斯坦引力中，阴影半径下界比光子球半径下界更稳健
decision.abstract_zh: 光子球与黑洞阴影是强场时空两个密切相关的几何特征：光子球是一个由圆形零测地线叶状分层构成的超曲面，而阴影边界由零测地线俘获的临界碰撞参数决定。对于 $n$ 维（$n\ge4$）爱因斯坦引力中具有各向异性物质的静态、球对称、渐近平坦黑洞，我们推导了阴影半径和光子球半径的下界，并比较了它们的物质假设。假设在视界与所考虑的光子球之间，辅助函数 $Ξ(r)$ 满足 $-ρ\leΞ\le p_r$ 和 $(r^2Ξ)'\ge0$，我们建立了 $r_γ\ge[(n-1)/2]^{1/(n-3)}r_H$，其中 $r_H$ 是事件视界半径。将阴影半径写为 $r_{\mathrm{sh}}=[\max_{r>r_H}U(r)]^{-1/2}$，其中 $U(r)$ 是零有效势，我们仅使用 $ρ\ge0$ 和 $ρ+p_r\ge0$（两者均由弱能量条件（WEC）蕴含）得到 $r_{\mathrm{sh}}/r_H\ge[(n-1)/2]^{1/(n-3)}\sqrt{(n-1)/(n-3)}$。该阴影下界与光子球的数量无关，且不需要光子球下界证明中使用的附加物质条件。在这个意义上，阴影半径的下界比光子球半径的下界更稳健。一个满足 WEC 的四维构型具有单个外部光子球并服从阴影下界，同时违反光子球下界不等式，表明即使两个半径都与同一光子球相关，这种区别依然存在。两个下界均被 Schwarzschild--Tangherlini 解饱和。在附录 A 中，我们还推导了在 WEC、强能量条件以及适当的渐近衰减假设下的质量相关上界。
